fields.description: Domain to send and receive mail for, e.g. acme.com. Cannot be changed.
fields.label: Domain Name

fields.description: Tenant that owns the domain. Cannot be changed.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: Shown on the cluster. Blank uses the tenant name.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Clear to stop sending and receiving. The domain must be verified again after it is enabled.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Tenant mail domain created with its hosted site. Suite Cloud publishes its records.
fields.label: Hosted

fields.description: Gets mail for addresses that do not exist. Blank rejects that mail.
fields.label: Catch-all Address

fields.description: Deliver user+tag@domain to user@domain.
fields.label: Sub-addressing

fields.description: Send mail for addresses without an account here to the domain's MX. Use when some mailboxes are on another server.
fields.label: Allow Relaying

fields.description: Pool for outbound mail of this domain. Overrides the tenant and cluster default.
fields.label: Egress Pool

fields.description: Set from the tenant.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: ID of the domain on the cluster. Blank if not created there.
fields.label: Stalwart ID

fields.description: SPF, DMARC and at least one DKIM record resolve. Mail flows only when the domain is verified and enabled. Checked hourly.
fields.label: Verified

fields.description: Verified without a DNS check because Skip Domain Verification is on.
fields.label: Verification Skipped

fields.description: The hourly check does not change Verified for this domain.
fields.label: Skip Scheduled Verification

fields.description: When the records were last checked.
fields.label: Last Verified At

fields.description: When the records were last read from the cluster.
fields.label: Records Refreshed At

fields.description: Show MTA-STS, autoconfig and autodiscover records. Turn on only if the tenant handles HTTPS for them.
fields.label: Publish Client Discovery Records

fields.description: Required. SPF, DKIM and DMARC records that stop others sending as this domain.
fields.label: Email Authentication

fields.description: Optional. Sends incoming mail for this domain to the cluster.
fields.label: Inbound Mail Routing

fields.description: Optional. Asks senders to use encrypted delivery and report failures.
fields.label: Transport Security

fields.description: Optional. Lets mail, calendar and contacts apps find the servers.
fields.label: Service Discovery

fields.description: Optional. Lets mail clients set up from an email address.
fields.label: Client Auto-configuration

fields.description: Zone file from the cluster. The tables above come from it.
fields.label: Zone File
